
# Configuración

Datos transcritos directamente en R de los registros publicados por el Instituto Costarricense de Turismo (ICT), suministrados por la Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería. Página de referencia: <https://app.powerbi.com/view?r=eyJrIjoiZGFjYTI5NTAtYmRiNy00ZjQ2LTk5ZDYtZGY2N2Q0YWNjNzcyIiwidCI6ImQwN2I2NTM1LTFkZGMtNDA2YS04MzQxLTBiMGEzMDlkNDExNSIsImMiOjR9>. No se requiere importar el CSV adjunto.

```{r}
# Instalar previamente los paquetes faltantes, si corresponde.
library(ggplot2)
library(forecast)
library(fpp2)
library(astsa)
library(tseries)
library(scales)
library(grid)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
dir.create("Figuras", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("Resultados", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
valores <- as.vector(t(base[, -1]))
turistas <- ts(valores, start = c(2009, 1), frequency = 12)
turistas
```

```{r}
stopifnot(length(turistas) == 204, !anyNA(turistas), all(turistas > 0))
write.csv(base, "Resultados/Datos_turismo_2009_2025.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
summary(turistas); sd(turistas)
```

```{r}
resumen_anual <- data.frame(
  Anio = base$Anio,
  Minimo = apply(base[, -1], 1, min),
  Q1 = apply(base[, -1], 1, quantile, probs = 0.25),
  Mediana = apply(base[, -1], 1, median),
  Media = apply(base[, -1], 1, mean),
  Q3 = apply(base[, -1], 1, quantile, probs = 0.75),
  Maximo = apply(base[, -1], 1, max),
  Desv_Estandar = apply(base[, -1], 1, sd)
)

resumen_anual[, -1] <- round(resumen_anual[, -1], 1)
resumen_anual
```

```{r}
base_larga <- base %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Anio,
    names_to = "Mes",
    values_to = "Llegadas"
  )

figura1 <- ggplot(base_larga, aes(x = Anio, y = Llegadas)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    linewidth = 0.5,
    fill = "#D9E2F3",
    colour = "#2F5597",
    outlier.colour = "#2F5597",
    outlier.size = 1.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Año",
    y = "Llegadas de turistas",
    caption = "Fuente: Instituto Costarricense de Turismo"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ","),
    breaks = seq(0, 350000, by = 50000)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.4,
      colour = "gray40"
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.4,
      colour = "gray40"
    ),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      hjust = 0,
      size = 10
    )
  )
```

# Partición cronológica

```{r}
train <- window(turistas, end = c(2024, 12)) #entrenamiento

test <- window(turistas, start = c(2025, 1)) #prueba

length(train)
length(test)
```

```{r}
autoplot(train, series = "Entrenamiento") +
  autolayer(test, series = "Prueba") +
  labs(
    x = "Año",
    y = "Llegadas de turistas",
    colour = "Conjunto de datos"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 350000, by = 50000),
    labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE, big.mark = ".")
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Suavizamiento exponencial

```{r}
ht1 <- hw(train, seasonal = "multiplicative", h = 12)

ht1$model
```

```{r}
accuracy(ht1)
```

```{r}
checkresiduals(ht1)
```

```{r}
ht2 <- hw(train, seasonal = "additive", h = 12)

ht2$model

accuracy(ht2)
```

```{r}
checkresiduals(ht2)
```

```{r}
ht3 <- hw(train, damped = TRUE,
          seasonal = "multiplicative", h = 12)

ht3$model

accuracy(ht3)
```

```{r}
checkresiduals(ht3)
```

```{r}
comparacion_hw <- rbind(
  Multiplicativo = accuracy(ht1),
  Aditivo = accuracy(ht2),
  Amortiguado = accuracy(ht3)
)

round(comparacion_hw, 4)
```

```{r}
autoplot(train) +
  autolayer(ht1$mean, series = "HW multiplicativo") +
  autolayer(ht2$mean, series = "HW aditivo") +
  autolayer(ht3$mean, series = "HW amortiguado") +
  xlab("Año") +
  ylab("Llegadas de turistas") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE,
                                big.mark = ".")
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Modelos ARIMA/SARIMA

```{r}
w <- log(train)
plot(w)
```

```{r}
png("Figuras/figura7.png", width = 2400, height = 1200, res = 300)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

Acf(w, main = "ACF")
Pacf(w, main = "PACF")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

dev.off()
# Alias para el artículo si se utilizó el nombre figura6.png.
file.copy("Figuras/figura7.png", "Figuras/figura6.png", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
adf.test(w)
```

```{r}
w12 <- diff(w, lag = 12)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

Acf(w12, main = "ACF")
Pacf(w12, main = "PACF")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}
autoplot(w) +
  xlab("Año") +
  ylab("Logaritmo de turistas") +
  theme_minimal()

autoplot(w12) +
  xlab("Año") +
  ylab("Diferencia estacional") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
adf.test(w12)
```

# Regresión convencional

```{r}
reg1 <- tslm(train ~ trend + season)

summary(reg1)
```

```{r}
reg2 <- tslm(train ~ trend + I(trend^2) + season)

summary(reg2)
```

```{r}
reg3 <- tslm(train ~ trend + season, lambda = 0)

summary(reg3)
```

```{r}
reg4 <- tslm(train ~ trend + I(trend^2) + season,
             lambda = 0)

summary(reg4)
```

```{r}
checkresiduals(reg1)

checkresiduals(reg2)

checkresiduals(reg3)

checkresiduals(reg4)
```

```{r}
rbind(
  reg1 = accuracy(reg1),
  reg2 = accuracy(reg2),
  reg3 = accuracy(reg3),
  reg4 = accuracy(reg4)
)
```

# Regresión dinámica e intervención

```{r}
trend <- seq_along(train) #tendencia
season <- seasonaldummy(train) #variables indicadoras de estacionalidad
```

```{r}
xreg <- cbind(trend, season)
```

```{r}
din1 <- auto.arima(train, d = 0, xreg = xreg)

summary(din1)

checkresiduals(din1)
```

```{r}
din2 <- auto.arima(train, d = 0,
                   xreg = xreg,
                   lambda = 0)

summary(din2)

checkresiduals(din2)
```

```{r}
pre_covid <- window(train, end = c(2020, 2))

plot(pre_covid)
```

```{r}
trend_pre <- seq_along(pre_covid)

season_pre <- seasonaldummy(pre_covid)

xreg_pre <- cbind(trend_pre, season_pre)
```

```{r}
din_pre <- auto.arima(pre_covid,
                      d = 0,
                      xreg = xreg_pre)

summary(din_pre)

checkresiduals(din_pre)
```

```{r}
I1 <- ifelse(time(train) >= 2020 + 2/12, 1, 0)

I2 <- ifelse(time(train) >= 2022, 1, 0)

covid <- I1 - I2

autoplot(ts(covid, start = c(2009, 1),
            frequency = 12))
```

```{r}
table(covid)
```

```{r}
xreg_covid <- cbind(xreg, covid)

din3 <- Arima(train,
              order = c(1, 0, 0),
              seasonal = c(1, 0, 0),
              xreg = xreg_covid)

summary(din3)

checkresiduals(din3)
```

```{r}
din4 <- auto.arima(train,
                   d = 0,
                   xreg = xreg_covid)

summary(din4)

checkresiduals(din4)
```

```{r}
din5 <- auto.arima(train,
                   d = 0,
                   xreg = xreg_covid,
                   lambda = 0)

summary(din5)

checkresiduals(din5)
```

```{r}
tiempo <- seq_along(train)

caida <- ifelse(tiempo >= 135 & tiempo <= 142, 1, 0)

recuperacion <- ifelse(tiempo >= 143 & tiempo <= 156, 1, 0)

table(caida)
table(recuperacion)
```

```{r}
xreg_covid2 <- cbind(xreg, caida, recuperacion)
```

```{r}
din6 <- auto.arima(train,
                   d = 0,
                   xreg = xreg_covid2)

summary(din6)

checkresiduals(din6)
```

# Comparación predictiva

```{r}
finalistas <- list("Holt-Winters aditivo" = ht2, "SARIMA" = mod4,
                   "Regresión convencional" = reg1, "Regresión dinámica" = din1)
diagnostico <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(finalistas), function(n) {
  m <- finalistas[[n]]
  lb <- checkresiduals(m, plot = FALSE)
  sw <- shapiro.test(na.omit(as.numeric(residuals(m))))
  data.frame(Modelo = n, Prueba = lb$method, Estadistico = unname(lb$statistic),
             gl = unname(lb$parameter), p_autocorrelacion = lb$p.value,
             W = unname(sw$statistic), p_normalidad = sw$p.value)
}))
print(diagnostico)
```

```{r}
pron1 <- ht2
```

```{r}
pron2 <- forecast(mod4, h = 12)
pron2$mean <- exp(pron2$mean)
pron2$lower <- exp(pron2$lower)
pron2$upper <- exp(pron2$upper)

pron2$x <- train
```

```{r}
pron3 <- forecast(reg1, h = 12)
```

```{r}
trend_test <- seq(length(train) + 1,
                  length(train) + 12)

season_test <- seasonaldummy(train, h = 12)

xreg_test <- cbind(trend_test, season_test)

colnames(xreg_test) <- colnames(xreg)

pron4 <- forecast(din1, xreg = xreg_test, h = 12)
```

```{r}
acc1 <- accuracy(pron1, test)["Test set", ]

acc2 <- accuracy(pron2$mean, test)

acc3 <- accuracy(pron3, test)["Test set", ]

acc4 <- accuracy(pron4, test)["Test set", ]

mase2 <- mean(abs(test - pron2$mean)) /
  mean(abs(diff(train, lag = 12)))
```

```{r}
comparacion <- rbind(
  "Holt-Winters" = acc1[c("RMSE", "MAE", "MAPE", "MASE")],
  "SARIMA" = c(acc2[1, c("RMSE", "MAE", "MAPE")],
               MASE = mase2),
  "Regresion" = acc3[c("RMSE", "MAE", "MAPE", "MASE")],
  "Regresion dinamica" = acc4[c("RMSE", "MAE", "MAPE", "MASE")]
)

round(comparacion, 4)
```



```{r}
estilo_articulo <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, colour = "gray40"),
  axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, colour = "gray40"),
  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
  plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 10), legend.position = "right")
figura8 <- autoplot(test, series = "Observado") +
  autolayer(pron1$mean, series = "Holt-Winters") +
  autolayer(pron2$mean, series = "SARIMA") +
  autolayer(pron3$mean, series = "Regresión") +
  autolayer(pron4$mean, series = "Regresión dinámica") +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Mes", y = "Llegadas de turistas", colour = "Modelo",
       caption = "Fuente: Elaboración propia con datos del ICT") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = as.numeric(time(test)),
    labels = c("Ene","Feb","Mar","Abr","May","Jun","Jul","Ago","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dic")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ","), breaks = seq(0,400000,50000)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Observado" = "black", "Holt-Winters" = "#E69F00",
    "SARIMA" = "#D55E00", "Regresión" = "#009E73", "Regresión dinámica" = "#0072B2"),
    breaks = c("Observado", "Holt-Winters", "SARIMA", "Regresión", "Regresión dinámica")) +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(Mes = as.numeric(time(test)), Llegadas = as.numeric(test)),
    aes(Mes, Llegadas), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  estilo_articulo
figura8
ggsave("Figuras/figura8.png", figura8, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

# Reestimación y diagnóstico final

```{r}
trend_total <- seq_along(turistas)

season_total <- seasonaldummy(turistas)

xreg_total <- cbind(trend_total, season_total)

colnames(xreg_total) <- colnames(xreg)
```

```{r}
modelo_final <- Arima(turistas,
                     order = c(4, 0, 0),
                     xreg = xreg_total)

summary(modelo_final)
checkresiduals(modelo_final)
```

```{r}
residuos_final <- residuals(modelo_final)
shapiro.test(residuos_final)
png("Figuras/figura9.png", width = 2400, height = 1800, res = 300, bg = "white")
checkresiduals(modelo_final)
dev.off()
```

# Pronósticos para 2026

```{r}
trend_futuro <- seq(length(turistas) + 1,
                    length(turistas) + 12)

season_futuro <- seasonaldummy(turistas, h = 12)

xreg_futuro <- cbind(trend_futuro, season_futuro)

colnames(xreg_futuro) <- colnames(xreg_total)
```

```{r}
pronostico_final <- forecast(modelo_final,
                             xreg = xreg_futuro,
                             h = 12,
                             level = c(80, 95))

pronostico_final
```

```{r}
figura10 <- autoplot(pronostico_final) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Año", y = "Llegadas de turistas",
       caption = "Fuente: Elaboración propia con datos del ICT") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ","), breaks = seq(0,450000,50000)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2009,2026,2)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Intervalo de predicción")) + estilo_articulo
figura10
ggsave("Figuras/figura10.png", figura10, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
tabla_final <- as.data.frame(pronostico_final)
round(tabla_final, 0)
sum(pronostico_final$mean)
```
